node.date_label: The Problem of Slavery in Western Culture (1966) · The Problem of Slavery in the Age of Revolution (1975) · Inhuman Bondage (2006)
node.description: Historian of slavery and abolition whose comparative intellectual history treated bondage as central to Western and Atlantic modernity. In his2008 retrospective,Davis asks how moral perception and organized opinion changed while slavery remained economically powerful. His interpretation gives ideas a major role in abolition; that emphasis,and his assessment of enslaved revolt,remain arguments rather than a settled hierarchy of causes.
